answer.claimed: Grant R21AI182745, Investigating ploidy modulation as a strategy to improve antibiotic activity (NIH / NIAID), for the period 2026-05-01 to 2026-05-31. Total requested: $7,060. Personnel (subtotal $5,130): research technician at 60% effort, $2,880, one pay period; graduate researcher at 50% effort, $2,250, one pay period. Equipment service (subtotal $1,290): rq-036, ultra-low freezer service contract from CoolChain, ordered 2026-05-01, $1,290 (changed from $1,150), aim: keeping isolate stocks at -80 C. Core facility services (subtotal $640): rq-038, genomics core sequencing run for 24 isolates from Campus Genomics Core, ordered 2026-05-20, $640, aim: confirming resistance genes.
answer.leftOut: rq-037 (Mueller-Hinton broth, 12 bottles, $1,460) is left out because held spending is left out; its invoice inv-037 is on hold after being billed for 24 bottles ($2,920) rather than the 12 bottles ordered ($1,460).
